title: Operator-Theoretic Generalization Bounds for Multitask Deep Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.15982v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop operator-theoretic generalization bounds for deep multi-output function classes by representing network layers as Koopman composition operators on vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces. In vector-valued Sobolev RKHSs, we derive Rademacher complexity bounds for invertible and width-expanding injective architectures. The estimates separate the output-coupling contribution, represented by the trace of the task matrix, from the layerwise operator norms, Sobolev symbol ratios, determinant factors, and restriction constants generated by the linear maps. We then analyze a distinct one-dimensional Brownian/Cameron--Martin regime. translated_title: 多任务深度学习的算子理论泛化界限
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15982v1 公告类型：新  摘要：我们通过将网络层表示为向量值再生核希尔伯特空间上的Koopman复合算子，为深度多输出函数类开发了算子理论的泛化界限。在向量值Sobolev RKHS中，我们推导了可逆和宽度扩展单射架构的Rademacher复杂度界限。这些估计将输出耦合贡献（由任务矩阵的迹表示）与层间算子范数、Sobolev符号比、行列式因子以及由线性映射生成的限制常数分离开来。然后，我们分析了一个不同的一维布朗/卡梅伦-马丁机制。利用向量值布朗RKHS的精确锚定导数范数特征，我们获得了域保持标量线性映射和锚定微分同胚激活的逐层界限；相应的因子分别按$|W_l|^{1/2}$和$\|\sigma_l'\|_\infty^{1/2}$缩放。
tldr: 本文通过算子理论框架，为多任务深度学习提出了新的泛化界限，将任务耦合与层间复杂度分离，并扩展至布朗RKHS机制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes novel operator-theoretic generalization bounds for multitask deep learning, separating task coupling from layerwise complexity and extending to the Brownian RKHS regime.
